facts.variant: D/CRCW e3; 10 kOhm; F tolerance; K TCR; EA packaging
facts.conditions: Tolerance is plus or minus 1 percent and TCR is plus or minus 100 ppm/K. Official ordering-code interpretation, not an observed inventory offer. EA denotes packaging, not a new electrical body size. TCR is specified through the stated temperature sequences; tolerance, temperature change and long-term drift are separate, not a combined accuracy guarantee. Zero-ohm jumper current and resistance limits do not apply.

facts.variant: D/CRCW e3; 10 kOhm; F tolerance; K TCR; EA packaging
facts.conditions: Page 2 summary applies to stability class 1, at P70/Umax; its extended 8000-hour cell is unspecified, not zero drift. Page 8 endurance procedure cycles 1.5 h on / 0.5 h off at 70 C and separately states permissible changes including additive ohmic terms. Do not replace this with unconditional 0.125 W or equate load drift with initial tolerance.
